inputs.normalization: Source-only; restore h/c mean/scale float32, C fill/mean/scale float64; network float32 highest

selection.primary: three-seed mean argmax, ties progress then menu order
selection.conservative: mean minus standard deviation; fallback to progress if below its predicted mean

development_review.rule: Source-only NLL selects branch initialization/checkpoint and positive controller weight; not external held-type winner picking. Report single-branch and shrinkage versions. Freeze current best within fixed candidate and training allocation even if targets fail.

pretraining_scope: Frozen generator/original critic historically trained on native Flow; warm starts do not erase that history
